title: OAuth SSO ATO: The Persistent Backdoor
description: Exploit a flawed OAuth implementation to permanently hijack another user's account by chaining a paywall bypass and an unverified email change.
objective: Take over the admin account and retrieve the flag hidden in the billing dashboard.
hints: Hint 1: Look at how the application verifies email changes. Does it send a confirmation link?
Hint 2: What happens if you change your email to the target's email before they reset their password?
Hint 3: After the victim regains access via password reset, does your active Google SSO session get invalidated? Try logging in with Google again.
Start by signing in with the provided SSO mock provider to bypass the payment screen.
Navigate to your account settings and change your email to the admin's email.
Log out and log back in using the SSO provider to see if you retain access.
Check the billing dashboard for the flag once you've successfully hijacked the admin session.
